makeup_policy: If the student is unable to appear for the Regular Test/Examination due to genuine exigencies, the student must refer to the procedure prescribed by AUGSD for applying for Make-up Test/Examination. Make-up will be granted only for extreme emergencies or for genuine reason(s). Proper proofs must be submitted along with the Make-up application. Prior permission of IC is compulsory. Decision of the IC in all matters of make-up shall be final. No make-up will be granted for the tutorials/lecture quizzes/discussion/projects/assignments.
